meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用图像生成脚本，根据你的描述生成或修改图片，并把结果保存为 PNG 文件。它还会检查 OpenRouter API 密钥是否配置。
howto.when: 当你要求生成照片、插画、概念图、logo 等图像，或要求修改已有图片时触发。如果是流程图、电路图等技术图表，会改用别的技能。

say.text: 生成一张夕阳下的山景图
say.note: 会调用脚本生成图片并保存为 PNG

say.text: 把这张照片的天空改成紫色
say.note: 需要提供图片路径，脚本会编辑后保存

say.text: 画一个未来感 AI 大脑概念图
say.note: 生成概念图，保存到当前目录

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the image generation script to create or edit images from your text descriptions and saves them as PNG files. It also checks whether an OpenRouter API key is configured.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to generate photos, illustrations, concept art, logos, or to edit an existing image. For technical diagrams like flowcharts or circuits, it uses a different skill.

say_en.note: Runs the script and saves a PNG

say_en.text: Make the sky purple in this photo
say_en.note: Edits the input image and saves the result

say_en.text: Create a futuristic AI brain concept art
say_en.note: Generates concept art in the current folder
